body: One of the jurors from Lil Durk @lildurk’s trial finally gave some insight into what was going through the jury’s mind. One thing that stood out to me was the “undercurrent” he described surrounding the witnesses and what they may have wanted from Durk. But suspicion and actually proving that Durk directed, ordered or paid for something are two very different things. Allegations are not findings of guilt.
